Every change is proved against the existing corpus at unchanged levels before it is proposed. A claim that a migration is mechanical is backed by a rewriter that reaches the whole corpus and a certification run that matches baseline item for item, including the failures — map_kv.th exits 1 before and after for an ens true that 7.1(a) rejects, and reproducing the rejection matters as much as reproducing the passes.
